headline: Cal State LA lead the division's unbeaten sides on wins
dek: Cal State LA beat Menlo and are still without a defeat, and no other unbeaten programme in the division has won as many matches. Lincoln and Emory & Henry also won and stay unbeaten; Midwestern State are the only other programme yet to lose.
displaced_by: results night: Cal State LA's win over Menlo kept them unbeaten with more wins than any other unbeaten programme in the division
